metrics.metric: Total Revenue milestones (2018 CEO Performance Award operational milestones, $20B to $175B)
metrics.evidence: any one of the following eight operational milestones focused on revenue or eight operational milestones focused on profitability, was met

metrics.metric: Adjusted EBITDA milestones (2018 CEO Performance Award operational milestones, $1.5B to $14B)
metrics.evidence: "Adjusted EBITDA" means (i) net income (loss) attributable to common stockholders before (ii) interest expense

metrics.metric: Market capitalization milestones (2018 CEO Performance Award, first tranche $100 billion, increasing by $50 billion increments)
metrics.evidence: the market capitalization milestone for such tranche, which began at $100 billion for the first tranche and increased by increments of $50 billion thereafter

metrics.metric: Sustained incremental $4 billion increase in market capitalization (2012 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: a sustained incremental $4 billion increase in Tesla's market capitalization from $3.2 billion

metrics.metric: Operational milestones relating to Model X or Model 3 development, aggregate vehicle production or gross margin target (2012 CEO Performance Award)
metrics.evidence: the achievement of a specified operational milestone relating to development of Model X or Model 3, aggregate vehicle production or a gross margin target
